source_truth: Historical Baseline train installation. Canonical queue remains authoritative; this manifest tells Codex where the HBI/SCI/IRQ/PRI/RHE/PPL/LSF/MGP/RRE batches belong and what prompt paths to execute.
canonical_queue_relationship: Preserve the active canonical queue. If SA17 is next eligible, run SA17 next and apply the Historical Baseline overlay to source/evidence/review scope. Insert the HBI family after Source Atlas import/review foundations and before downstream source-aware personalization claims.

placement.purpose: Source and evidence import primitives inherit Historical Baseline source-record, evidence, receipt, and review-gating constraints.
Document classification, candidate extraction, and review surfaces must support Historical Baseline candidates without creating active goals directly.
Dedicated Historical Baseline completion train after Source Atlas foundations and before downstream source-aware personalization maturity claims.
Downstream batches may not claim source-aware personalization maturity until relevant HBI proof exists.
